item.title: Acer and Asus ordered to halt PC sales in Germany after Nokia wins HEVC patent ruling
item.description: At the center of the case is the widely used video compression standard HEVC, also known as H.265. Nokia owns several standard-essential patents tied to the codec and argued that Acer and Asus failed to obtain proper licenses under fair, reasonable, and non-discriminatory (FRAND) terms.Read Entire Article

item.title: Chrome rushes emergency patch for actively exploited zero-day bug
item.description: Google has pushed an emergency update for Chrome to close a high-severity zero-day vulnerability that's already being exploited in the wild.
